about: Round 78: ic72-roles-string of round72/incoming-claims.json, an Incoming-Token the stand refuses on check/resource, sent on bulk, bulk/operations and check/filter v1. The first and the last case are the controls of the source file.

cases.about: Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.
